title: fx68k
_note: The chipsalliance/sv-tests core (generators/fx68k), pinned at the commit sv-tests pins.  A cycle-accurate Motorola 68000 -- the one NON-RISC-V CPU core in the sv-tests list.  sv-tests compiles exactly three files (fx68k.sv, fx68kAlu.sv, uaddrPla.sv) and names no top module, so every module is swept on its own.  No packages and no include directories.  sv-tests' own coverage note says this core "needs --allow-dup-initial-drivers under slang", so that flag is passed to read_slang here too: without it slang refuses a module whose `initial` blocks drive the same variable more than once, and the row would lose its reference.
